### [`api.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/api.ts)

- `tripRegionCacheTag` _function_: The Data Cache tag on every read of a region, for the API's revalidation webhook.
- `tripTicketsCacheTag` _function_: The Data Cache tag of a region's ticket catalog, which the API revalidates after every edit.
- `getTripRegionTickets` _function_: The ticket catalog as the admin keeps it (`/tickets`): open, five minutes at the edge, and revalidated by tag on every edit. The region route's own `tickets` is the fallback while this route is missing or failing.
- `getTripRegion` _function_: The region: its parks, groups, hotel areas and travel legs. Open, curated in code.
- `getTripRegionLinks` _function_: The live regions a page can link into, for the bands on park, calendar, city, country and post pages and `/search`.
- `getTripRegionNavFacts` _function_: What the band says of each live region, by slug: the API's list of regions (`GET /v1/trip-regions`), else for the park count each region route's park list, both a day in the Data Cache.
- `getTripRegionWhen` _function_: The best trip windows of a length in a range, planned for the headliner parks unless `parks` says otherwise (`/when`).
- `getTripRegionCalendar` _function_: Every park's days side by side, with the seasons that run on them; at most 92 days.
- `getTripRegionBestDays` _function_: Each park's quiet and busy days in a window, as sets, and each resort's best dates.
- `getTripRegionSchoolBreaks` _function_: The school-holiday regions the holiday data knows in `countries` (`DE,NL,GB`), each with its breaks in the range and the day its data ends. Open: the data key stays home.
- `TRIP_REGIONS_CACHE_TAG` _const_: The Data Cache tag of the list of regions (`GET /v1/trip-regions`).
- Types: `TripWindow`, `TripRegionNavFacts`

### [`best-time.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/best-time.ts)

- `parseBestTimePage` _function_: The page a `[[...resort]]` segment list asks for in a region, or `null` for a 404: the region's own page where it has one, or a resort's by its segment.
- `bestTimeYear` _function_: The year in the title: the coming year from September on, else the current one, so the page answers the trip people are booking.
- `bestTimeRange` _function_: The range `/when` and `/school-breaks` are asked for: the title's year, from today at the earliest and never past the year ahead both routes accept.
- `bestTimeParks` _function_: The headliner parks a page plans, in the region's order.
- `bestTimeWhenQuery` _function_: The one `/when` query a best-time page and the hub's teaser send for the same parks, so both read one cached answer and never print two figures for one window. The gap is the trip's length: the windows named side by side never overlap.
- `noWhenAnswer` _function_: The page's `/when` when the route did not answer (a revoked data key, the API down): no window, week or month, so the page says it has no figures yet ("No 10-day trip in 2027 has figures yet") instead of failing, as every page does without …
- `monthKey` _function_: `YYYY-MM` of a month.
- `monthRows` _function_: The month table: every month of the title's year from the current one on, each with `/when`'s figures where its range reaches, a tier among the months that have a figure, and its day guests' hours against the year's mean.
- `cleanBreakName` _function_: A school break's name without the district and the day's other holidays: "Spring break (Orange County Public Schools)" → "Spring break", "Winter break (…), New Year's Day" → "Winter break".
- `breakRuns` _function_: Consecutive break days as runs: the weekends `/when` lists without a name join the break they border, so "13–15 Feb" reads as Presidents' Day, not as two blanks and a holiday.
- `europeanBreaks` _function_: Each country's regions with a real break in a month, in `countries`' order.
- `tripLongBreaks` _function_: A region's breaks long enough for a trip of `days`, cut to `range`: what chapter 04 links the planner's When mode to.
- `isWholeWeek` _function_: Whether a week lies wholly inside a range, so its figure is a whole week's.
- `bestAndWorstWeeks` _function_: The quietest and busiest whole weeks, `count` each, quietest and busiest first.
- `seasonsOn` _function_: The seasons that run on a day range, one per name, cancelled and closures left out.
- `weekFacts` _function_: A week's school breaks (from the months' break days) and the seasons running in it.
- `lastYearFrom` _function_: The first day `/when` reads last year's crowds: its `forecastUntil` + 1, else the strip's turn.
- `holidayWeek` _function_: The week the page answers "Is Christmas busy?" with: Christmas week where the range holds it, else New Year's, else none.
- `meanWeekWait` _function_: The mean of the weeks' figures: the year's average a week is compared with.
- `partySeasons` _function_: The party nights a page's parks hold: separately ticketed Halloween and Christmas evenings.
- `wettestMonths` _function_: The wettest months by their climate normal, wettest first.
- `planOrder` _function_: The order a window's plan visits the page's parks in: each park's first day, earliest first. The honest answer to "Disney or Universal first?": the plan puts each park on its quietest day.
- `windowList` _function_: Windows as one phrase in the reader's language, "16–25 Feb, 1–10 Mar and 6–15 Apr", for the first answer's sentence and the meta description.
- `flatStretch` _function_: A flat stretch around the first window: the run of weeks whose figure stays within a couple of minutes of the quietest week, when it is long enough that naming one window would rank a tie. `null` when the year has a real low.
- `REGION_BEST_TIME_PAGE` _const_: The id of a region's own best-time page; a resort's page is its segment.
- `BEST_TIME_TRIP_DAYS` _const_: The trip length every page ranks, the planner's own default.
- `BEST_TIME_WINDOWS` _const_: The windows the first answer names.
- `EUROPEAN_BREAK_MIN_DAYS` _const_: A European break counts in a month only when it runs at least this many days, weekends included: a bridge day (Maundy Thursday, Ascension) is not a family's trip.
- Types: `BestTimePageId`, `MonthHours`, `BestTimeMonthRow`, `BreakRun`, `CountryBreaks`, `WeekFacts`

### [`hub-data.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/hub-data.ts)

- `regionGroups` _function_: The region's groups with their parks: the three resorts, then the day trips.
- `withGroupNames` _function_: The region with its day-trip group named in the reader's language: the API names it in English, while a resort's name is the operator's own and stays as it is.
- `regionResorts` _function_: The resorts alone: the groups a day's shortest line is named for.
- `shortParkName` _function_: The words a park's name carries that every visitor drops: the operator's prefix, "Park", "Theme Park", the place (a region's `parkNameSuffixes`).
- `closesEarly` _function_: Whether a day closes early for the day guest: the API says so (`closesEarly`), or a separately ticketed evening follows, which sends the day guests out before it starts.
- `dayGuestClose` _function_: When the day guests leave: the API's `dayGuestCloseAt`, else the day's own close.
- `isRankable` _function_: Whether a park can be ranked on a day: not closed, with a figure.
- `hoursUnpublished` _function_: Whether a day has a figure but no published hours yet: drawn with its mark, said in words.
- `rankGroupParks` _function_: A group's parks on a day: the API's pick first where the group has one (its cost weighs the day guest's hours, so it can be a full day over a slightly shorter wait that closes early), then the open parks with a figure by `headlinerWait`, …
- `shortestLines` _function_: Each resort's shortest line on a day, from the API's `best` map. A resort without an entry (a last-year day, no figure) is left out rather than guessed, and so is a pick the region does not know.
- `glanceDay` _function_: The day the first answer is about: today in the region, or tomorrow once every resort's pick has closed to day guests, since nobody plans the rest of a day that is over. A day without picks counts as open.
- `firstDays` _function_: The first `count` days of the calendar from `fromIso` on.
- `isWeekend` _function_: `true` when a date is a weekend (Saturday or Sunday); the date is already the region's.
- `formatHubDate` _function_: A plain date as the hub prints it, anchored at noon UTC so no zone moves it: `short` "Thu 12 Nov", `long` "Thursday, 12 November", `day` "12", `weekday` "Thu".
- `formatHubMonth` _function_: A month's name with its year, "December 2026", in the reader's language.
- `dayBasis` _function_: The basis most of a day's parks share, so a column can say "last year" once.
- `eventLanes` _function_: The lanes under the matrix: each curated season that runs on a day of the window (party nights, festivals, Universal's holidays as `expected`), one lane per name even where several parks run it, then the school breaks as runs of days.
- `findLeg` _function_: The legs between two places, in either direction (`hotel:<key>` or a park slug).
- `legMinutes` _function_: The door-to-door minutes of a drive: to the car park, then the curated rest of the way.
- `meanWait` _function_: The mean of some waits, rounded to five like every wait the site prints; `null` for none.
- `weekendAgainstWeekday` _function_: A park's figures on weekends against weekdays across the window, last-year days left out.
- `ticketedEvenings` _function_: A park's ticketed evenings in the window: how many, when the day guests leave, how busy.
- `resortMonthSummaries` _function_: Each resort's month: the best dates from `/best-days` (the API ranks them on the unrounded figures), and from the calendar the two days with the highest mean over the resort's parks that have a figure, so a day most of its parks call quiet …
- `tintLevel` _function_: The crowd levels a cell may be tinted by: the six of the scale, never closed or unknown.
- `hubWindow` _function_: The hub's window for a page: the 30 days from today on the hub, the month on a month page.
- `tripRegionToday` _function_: A region's today, in its own zone, never the server's or the browser's.
- `shortGroupName` _function_: A resort's name without "Resort": "Walt Disney World", "Universal Orlando".
- `parkGeo` _function_: The geo segments of a region park's path (`/parks/<continent>/<country>/<city>/<slug>`).
- `glanceLines` _function_: The shortest lines the first answer names: each resort where the pick beat another park that day.
- `sliceCalendar` _function_: The calendar trimmed to a window of its days, with the seasons that run in it.
- `slimRegion` _function_: The region as the hub's client part needs it: the parks, groups and hotel areas, and only the legs from a hotel area to a park, which the day sheet's travel line reads.
- `formatDateRange` _function_: Two dates as one short range in the reader's language ("Jan 12 – 21", "12.–21. Jan.", "27 Apr – 6 May"): `Intl`'s own range format, which knows each locale's order and what to leave out.
- `formatWindow` _function_: A trip window's dates as one short range (`formatDateRange`).
- `HUB_FIRST_DAYS` _const_: How many days the first answer covers: the server-rendered week.
- `HUB_WINDOW_DAYS` _const_: How far the hub's calendar reaches past today: the API's default window.
- Types: `RegionGroup`, `RankedPark`, `ShortestLine`, `HubBasis`, `EventLane`, `ResortMonthSummary`

### [`local-choice.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/local-choice.ts)

- `localChoice` _function_: A `LocalChoice` under `key`, holding one of `values`.

### [`paths.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/paths.ts)

- `tripRegionGuidePath` _function_: The region's guide to its planner, a blog post (`/blog/<slug>` in the locale), where the planner's options are explained at length; `null` where the region has none yet.
- `tripRegionPath` _function_: The locale-relative path of a region's hub or one of its months (`/orlando`, `/orlando/2026/12`). The month is unpadded, so each month has one URL; the proxy 308s the padded spelling.
- `tripRegionBestTimePath` _function_: The locale-relative path of a region's "best time to visit" pages: the region's own (`/orlando/beste-reisezeit`) or a resort's (`/orlando/best-time-to-visit/disney-world`).
- `tripRegionMonthHref` _function_: The address to link a month by: the hub for the current month, whose canonical it is, and the month's own URL for every other, so the site never mints a URL that only canonicals away.
- `isSameMonth` _function_: Whether two months are the same month.
- `currentTripRegionMonth` _function_: Today's month in the region, never the server's or the browser's: the hub, the window and the proxy agree on which month "this month" is across midnight elsewhere.
- `tripRegionMonths` _function_: The months a hub serves, from the current one on.
- `isTripRegionMonthInRange` _function_: Whether a month is one a hub serves: the current one or one of the eleven after it.
- `parseTripRegionMonth` _function_: The month the `[[...date]]` segments ask for: `null` for the hub, `'invalid'` for segments that are not a month the hub serves (a 404, or a 308 the proxy has already answered), and `padded` for `/2026/09`, which the proxy 308s to `/2026/9`.
- `tripMonthRange` _function_: The first and last day of a month, `YYYY-MM-DD`, for a `/calendar` or `/best-days` window.
- `monthOfDate` _function_: The month a `YYYY-MM-DD` date falls in.
- `tripRegionRelayUrl` _function_: Where a page asks for one of a region's keyed routes: the same-origin relay (`app/api/trip-regions/[...path]/route.ts`), which adds the site's data key. The query names are the API's own.
- `TRIP_PLANNER_ID` _const_: The anchor of the hub's planner chapter, which the hero's action and Parky's links open.
- `TRIP_CALENDAR_ID` _const_: The anchor of chapter 01, the calendar, for the park bands and the homepage teaser.
- `TRIP_REGION_MONTH_COUNT` _const_: How many months a hub serves: the current month (the hub itself) and the eleven after it, in the region's time. Past `forecastUntil` a month reads last year's measured days with a banner.
- Types: `TripRelayRoute`

### [`plan-analytics.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/plan-analytics.ts)

- `trackTripEvent` _function_: Report a trip planner event for the region it plans, by its slug (`orlando`).
- `sellerProp` _function_: A seller's name as a property value: the characters the statistic keeps, at most 60.
- `hostProp` _function_: A link's host without `www.`, or `unknown` for a url that is none.
- `ticketModeOf` _function_: Which tickets a plan was made with, from the plan's own tickets and suggestions.
- `ticketLinkClickProps` _function_: `ticket_link_clicked` for one link of the list a visitor saw, `index` 0-based in that list.
- `tripDaysBucket` _function_: A trip's length as a bucket, arrival and departure included.
- `tripPlanRequestProps` _function_: `trip_plan_requested` from the request's own query, the API's names: what the visitor decided, never the dates themselves. `parks` 0 is the headliners, the API's default.
- `tripPlanShownProps` _function_: `trip_plan_shown` for a plan on screen: ok, or relaxed with the rule, and what it left out.
- `tripWhenShownProps` _function_: `trip_plan_shown` for a search's answer, with the windows it found.
- `tripPlanFailedProps` _function_: `trip_plan_shown` for a request that failed, with its status (0: no answer at all).
- Types: `TripEventName`, `TripEventProps`, `TripEventArgs`, `TrackTripEvent`

### [`plan-copy.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/plan-copy.ts)

- `climateChips` _function_: The climate chips of a day's or a window's warnings, in order, the season folded into its peak.
- `eveningReasons` _function_: An evening's reasons this client can say, in order.
- `primaryReason` _function_: The one-line reason of a day: the first code of `PLAN_REASON_ORDER` or `REST_REASON_ORDER` it carries.
- `dayWarnings` _function_: A day's warnings this client can say, in order, the two spellings of a back-to-back repeat folded into one.
- `closesEarly` _function_: Whether the day guests leave early that day: the API's flag, or one of its two codes.
- `dayMarker` _function_: The one marker of a day in the overview, or `null`.
- `relaxedRules` _function_: Rules the plan loosened, as `tripPlanner.relaxed.*` (or the region's own) keys; unknown ones are dropped.
- `parksLeftOut` _function_: The chosen parks that got no day at all because the trip has too few park days, in the region's order: the API's `parksLeftOut` where it sends it, else the parks `unplaced` names with no visit on any day.
- `windowParksLeftOut` _function_: The chosen parks a found window has no day for, and its park days, for the same sentence the plan says: the API's `parksLeftOut` where it sends it, else the chosen parks its day-by-day sketch does not name.
- `unplacedParks` _function_: A park the plan could not place, with a reason this client can say. A park `parksLeftOut` names is said there; a park with a day that lost a repeat visit reads `no_second_day`.
- `ignoredLocks` _function_: Pins the plan could not keep, with a reason this client can say.
- `planSavings` _function_: The savings sentence's figures, or `null` where the totals carry none.
- `lastYearReach` _function_: When the forecast should reach the trip's first `last_year` day: the horizon (today to `forecastUntil`) moves forward a day a day, so it reaches that day as many days before it as the horizon is long. Never before tomorrow.
- `runnerUp` _function_: The runner-up of a park's visit on `date`: the best alternative day, with how many minutes more (or fewer) its headliners wait. `null` without one or without both figures.
- `earlyPerk` _function_: The early slot a day's hotel gets, if any, by the region's own name for it.
- `editCost` _function_: The edit bar's figure: what the visitor's pins cost against the best order the plan had before them, per ride, in whole minutes. `null` without both means; 0 reads as "no cost".
- `autoSplit` _function_: The parks the split gave a second (or third) day, for the answer's "we added a second day at Magic Kingdom Park". Only entries the API marks `auto` with more than one visit; anything else in `meta.split` is ignored.
- `PLAN_REASON_ORDER` _const_: The reasons a park day can carry, most telling first: the one-line reason is the first present.
- `REST_REASON_ORDER` _const_: A rest day's reasons, most telling first.
- `PLAN_WARNING_ORDER` _const_: The warnings, most consequential first. `repeat_back_to_back` and `adjacent_repeat` say the same thing (two visits of one park on consecutive days, because nothing else fitted); the API names it either way depending on its version, so both …
- `EVENING_REASON_ORDER` _const_: Why an evening after the park is worth it, most telling first; the sheet says the first.
- Types: `PlanReasonCode`, `RestReasonCode`, `ClimateChip`, `EveningReasonCode`, `PlanWarningCode`, `DayMarker`, `UnplacedPark`, `PlanSavings`

### [`plan-fetch.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/plan-fetch.ts)

- `retryPlanRequest` _function_: Whether a failed request is worth asking again.
- `planQueryKey` _function_: The plan's cache key: its region and request query, in the order the URL writes it.
- `calendarQueryKey` _function_: A calendar window's cache key, shared by the date sheet and the result.
- `fetchTripPlan` _function_: `GET …/plan` through the relay. Throws a `PlanRequestError`.
- `fetchTripCalendar` _function_: `GET …/calendar` through the relay, for a window of at most 92 days.
- `whenQueryKey` _function_: The When search's cache key: its region and request query.
- `fetchTripWhen` _function_: `GET …/when` through the relay. Throws a `PlanRequestError`.
- `schoolBreaksQueryKey` _function_: The school-holiday regions' cache key, per trip region (its route answers them).
- `fetchSchoolBreaks` _function_: `GET …/school-breaks` through the relay, for the countries the When mode's picker offers.
- `PlanRequestError` _class_: A request the planner could not complete. `invalid` is the API's 400: the trip as asked cannot be planned, and asking again changes nothing, so it is not retried. `failed` is anything else (the network, a 5xx, the relay's 502) and is.
- `PLAN_DEBOUNCE_MS` _const_: How long the planner waits for the controls to settle before it asks for a plan.

### [`plan-ics.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/plan-ics.ts)

- `icsEscape` _function_: Text as a property value: backslash, semicolon, comma and line breaks escaped.
- `icsFold` _function_: A content line folded at 75 octets, continuation lines opening with a space. Folded by bytes, never inside a multi-byte character, because the limit is in octets and a park name may carry an accent.
- `icsLocalDateTime` _function_: `YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS` of an instant on the wall clock of `timeZone`.
- `buildTripIcs` _function_: The calendar file for a trip, timed in the region's zone. `now` stamps every event (`DTSTAMP`); it is a parameter so the file is a function of its input. CRLF line ends, as the format requires.
- Types: `TripIcsEvent`

### [`plan-photos.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/plan-photos.ts)

- `tripPlannerPhotos` _function_: The region parks' photos for the planner's Week view, one per park that has a park background in the media database.

### [`plan-query.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/plan-query.ts)

- `isPlanDate` _function_: A real `YYYY-MM-DD` day, not `2026-02-31`.
- `planRegionKeys` _function_: The slugs, hotel areas, tickets and resorts a link may name, from the region the page rendered.
- `readTicketItem` _function_: One `tickets=` item, or `null` where it cannot be read.
- `writeTicketItem` _function_: One ticket in its URL form, the flags in the contract's order.
- `readTickets` _function_: A link's `tickets` read leniently, one item at a time, at most `MAX_TICKETS`; `dropped` counts the items that could not be read, so the planner can say one was left out.
- `readBases` _function_: A link's `bases`, one item at a time: an unknown base or a second item for one goes, an area of another base or on a `:0` base is dropped from its item (the API answers either with a 400).
- `writeBaseItem` _function_: One base in its URL form: `tokyo:4@maihama`.
- `readPlanQuery` _function_: The state a URL describes. Lenient by design: a link from Parky, an old copy or a hand edit opens what can be read and drops the rest, one parameter at a time, so a single bad value never costs the visitor the whole plan.
- `normalizePlanState` _function_: The state with what cannot hold dropped: a pin outside the trip, on a park not chosen (the API answers either with a 400), or the second pin of a day. Called after every change, so the URL and the request never carry one.
- `planQueryEntries` _function_: The state as `/plan` query pairs, in `PLAN_QUERY_NAMES` order, with each value that is the API's default left out so a link stays short.
- `writePlanQuery` _function_: The query string for the address bar, `''` for the untouched state. Commas, colons, `@` and the `?` of `.h?` stay readable: `URLSearchParams` would encode them, and a link Parky prints should look like the one the page writes.
- `planHref` _function_: The address of this plan on `pathname` (the hub or a month page), opening on the planner, which "Copy link" shares and `history.replaceState` writes after each change.
- `plannerHrefOn` _function_: The locale-relative address that opens the planner on a state, for `Link` from `@/i18n/navigation`: `/orlando?from=…&to=…&parks=…#planner`, or in the When mode `/orlando?when=<from>_<to>&days=10&within=DE-NW&parks=…#planner`.
- `MAX_TRIP_DAYS` _const_: A trip runs at most three weeks, arrival and departure included.
- `MAX_VISITS_PER_PARK` _const_: A park takes at most this many visits.
- `MAX_PLAN_VISITS` _const_: A plan places at most this many visits, repeats included.
- `MAX_REST_STREAK` _const_: `rest=max:n` takes n from 1 to this.
- `MAX_DAYS_AHEAD` _const_: A plan reaches at most a year ahead.
- `MIN_FIND_DAYS` _const_: The When mode's shortest trip.
- `DEFAULT_FIND_DAYS` _const_: The When mode's trip length before the visitor sets one.
- `MAX_TICKETS` _const_: A plan takes at most this many owned tickets.
- `DEFAULT_PLAN_STATE` _const_: The state before the visitor has chosen anything: the API's defaults, no dates.
- `PLAN_QUERY_NAMES` _const_: The query names in the order a URL is written in, the `/plan` route's own. `parties` is not one of them: it is read from older links (see `readPlanQuery`) and never written.
- `DEFAULT_MOVE_BUFFERS` _const_: The hotel-change buffers the contract names, for a region answer that does not list its own.
- Types: `PlanHotel`, `PlanRest`, `PlanLock`, `PlanParkPick`, `PlanTicketHopper`, `PlanTicket`, `PlanBasePick`, `PlanSearchRange`, `TripPlanState`, `PlanRegionKeys`, `QueryReader`, `TripPlannerHrefInput`

### [`plan-stays.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/plan-stays.ts)

- `planStays` _function_: The plan's stays in route order, numbered; empty in a region without bases.
- `movesBetweenStays` _function_: Whether the plan sleeps in more than one place, the one case the stays are drawn at all.
- `dayStayBase` _function_: The stay a day is listed under: where it is spent.
- `staySections` _function_: The trip's days in sections, one per stay in route order, each opening on the move that reaches it. A region without bases, or a plan with one stay, is one section without a stay.
- `stayHalves` _function_: Each day's two halves for the Week view's stay band: the first belongs to the city the day starts in, the second to the city it ends in, so a stay runs from the second half of its arrival day to the first half of its departure day.
- `stayBandRuns` _function_: The band's runs: consecutive halves of one city merged, gaps (before arrival, after departure) left out.
- `gatewayChoices` _function_: The Route step's choices: per base the gateways only it lists, in the region's base order, and last the gateways several bases share, which pin nothing (the contract: a gateway pins a base only when exactly one base lists it).
- `baseLeg` _function_: The leg between two bases, either way round.
- `moveMinutes` _function_: A move's minutes from leaving to arriving, park-local ISO times, else the leg's own figure.
- `monthStayCells` _function_: Each date's stay for the Month view's band, by date; empty when the plan sleeps in one place, which draws no band.
- Types: `PlanStayRun`, `PlanStaySection`, `StayHalf`, `StayBandRun`, `GatewayChoice`, `MonthStayCell`

### [`plan-tickets.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/plan-tickets.ts)

- `hopperResorts` _function_: The resorts whose catalog sells a hopper as an option: where plan first's `hopper=` can name one.
- `ticketCatalog` _function_: The catalog keyed by id; empty without one.
- `leanTicketCatalog` _function_: The catalog as the browser needs it: the operators' notes and the rules only the optimizer reads (`hopSets`, `caps`, `confidence`) stay on the server, which keeps the planner's payload small.
- `ticketEntries` _function_: A resort's product list, keeping only the products the catalog has; an entry with none left goes, so a product the API drops leaves the list without a dead button.
- `entryOfProduct` _function_: The entry a written ticket belongs to: the first that lists its product and is no "not sure".
- `ticketHomeMarket` _function_: The market code of a ticket sold to anyone at the operator's: the region's `ticketMarkets.home`, else the registry's for an API that does not send it.
- `entryMarket` _function_: Whether an entry's ticket is sold abroad only, which its tag says ("Sold outside the US").
- `soldLengths` _function_: The lengths a product sells, or `null` for a pass or a product with only a window.
- `windowLength` _function_: The calendar days a ticket may be used in, from its start: the window of its length, or the product's own window; `null` for a pass.
- `ticketLength` _function_: The days a ticket of this product has to count off, `null` for a pass or a window-only product.
- `isEveryDayTicket` _function_: Whether a ticket is valid every day of its window, so it has no days to count off: a window as long as its days (Universal's UK 14-day tickets), or a window without a day count (SeaWorld's Four Parks).
- `onSaleAt` _function_: Whether the product is sold for a ticket starting on `date`.
- `ticketWindow` _function_: A ticket's window as dates, both ends included; `null` without a start or for a pass.
- `rollingFortnightAt` _function_: The region's rolling 14-day tickets sold for a start (Universal's UK ones, Three Park Adventure first): one product in most weeks, both in the week their sales overlap (the step then asks about the add-on), none outside, and none where the …
- `unsureLengths` _function_: The lengths "Not sure which" offers: every date-based length, and the UK ticket's 14.
- `draftProduct` _function_: The product a draft stands for, or `null` while it cannot be told: the entry's chosen chip, its add-on, the UK 14-day ticket on sale at the start, or for "not sure" the strictest product of that length (a date-based ticket, or the UK …
- `draftTicket` _function_: The draft as a `tickets=` item, or why not: `null` with no issue while a field is still empty. A start the product is not sold for is an issue, never written, since the API would refuse it.
- `ticketDraft` _function_: A written ticket as a draft, so the step opens on what the link says.
- `ticketWindows` _function_: Each ticket's window with its resort, in entry order, for the date grid's bars and key.
- `tripFromTickets` _function_: The trip the tickets imply, for dates not chosen yet: the earliest first day to the latest window's end, at most `MAX_TRIP_DAYS` days. `null` while no ticket has a first day.
- `setTickets` _function_: Set the tickets; where the trip has no dates yet, the tickets' windows give them.
- `ticketProblem` _function_: The first ticket the trip cannot be planned with: one that starts after the trip, one whose window ends before it, or a start the product is not sold for. `null` while there are no dates.
- `hopperTicketResorts` _function_: The resorts the visitor's owned tickets cover with a hopper (`.h`, or a product that always hops), for the "Park hopping" option, which only these and plan first's hopper make count.
- `ticketsCoverBothResorts` _function_: Whether owned tickets cover both of the region's `blockResorts` (Disney and Universal), so the two may mix inside the windows.
- `hopperOn` _function_: Whether a plan-first resort is planned with its hopper: all are with `ticket=hopper`, else `hopper=` names it.
- `toggleHopper` _function_: "Show the plan with Park Hopper" for one resort, and its way back. An older link's `ticket=hopper` (every resort) becomes the list of the others, so the press changes only this resort.
- `suggestionsByStart` _function_: The suggestions in the order of their first day, for the one sentence that names them.
- `adoptSuggestions` _function_: "Use these as your tickets": the suggestions written as owned tickets, each with its start and, where the plan was shown with it, the hopper.
- `longStayTickets` _function_: "From the UK or Ireland? The 14-day tickets fit this trip": the region's 14-day tickets sold abroad (Disney's and Universal's) for the resorts a long trip's suggestions name, without a first day, so the plan picks it.
- `hopperGains` _function_: What the hopper adds, from the fields the API sends: each evening at a second park and each day with two parks by date (more than two by count), the parks that fit only with it, and the minutes per ride. Empty when it adds nothing.
- `needsConnectedHop` _function_: Whether a set of planned parks holds both of the region's `connectedParks` (Universal Studios and Islands of Adventure, with the Hogwarts Express between them), a ride only a hopper takes.
- `ticketDayOf` _function_: Where a plan day sits on its ticket, from `ticket` and `ticketDay` and the ticket the meta names; `null` for a day without a ticket and for a water-park visit on the allowance.
- `ownedUse` _function_: An owned ticket's use, read the contract's way for its kind of product.
- `plannedVisits` _function_: The planned visits of a park, for "Leave this visit out" on a day outside its ticket.
- `visitorMarket` _function_: The visitor's market from the browser's languages: `us` or `uk` where the first one names the US, Great Britain or Ireland, `intl` for any other region, `null` without one.
- `orderTicketLinks` _function_: A product's purchase links in the order a visitor sees them: those for the visitor's locale or market first, the rest after, each group in the admin's order, which is the display order. The official link keeps its place.
- `ticketLinkAttributes` _function_: The attributes of a purchase link. Sellers have to see that a visitor came from park.fan, so no `noreferrer`, and `referrerPolicy="origin"` overrides the site's `same-origin` policy for this one link: the seller gets `https://park.fan/`, …
- Types: `TicketCatalog`, `TicketResort`, `TicketEntry`, `TicketDraft`, `DraftIssue`, `TicketProblem`, `HopperGain`, `TicketDayInfo`, `OwnedUse`

### [`plan-view.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/plan-view.ts)

- `tripPlanView` _function_: The view chosen in a region's planner, as an external store (`parkfan_<region>_view`), one per region so each keeps the key its browsers already hold.
- `PLAN_VIEWS` _const_: The result's three views.
- Types: `PlanView`

### [`plan-week.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/plan-week.ts)

- `parkMinuteOf` _function_: Minutes since the trip day's midnight in `timeZone`, for a park-local ISO instant: past midnight runs on (25:00 is 01:00 the next morning), so a close after midnight stays below the opening.
- `planTimeMinute` _function_: Minutes since the trip day's midnight for a time the plan gives as park-local ISO or as `HH:MM`; an `HH:MM` before 05:00 is after midnight.
- `calendarCell` _function_: The calendar cell of a park on a date, if the calendar has it.
- `tripDaySpans` _function_: Each trip day's pieces, read off the plan and the calendar. A park day whose hours the calendar does not carry gets no block: the honest answer is the day planner's, no axis rather than an invented one.
- `tripCanvas` _function_: The shared canvas, from the earliest piece of any day to the latest, on whole hours and padded by the planner's own `PRE_PAD_MIN` and `POST_PAD_MIN`. `null` when no day has hours.
- `tripColumnGrid` _function_: A column's axis: the day planner's `DayGrid` for that day's hours, stretched onto the shared canvas. Real minutes, not the API's rounded hours, so there is no closing slack to hatch.
- `weekPages` _function_: The trip's dates in pages of `perPage`, from the first day: page by week, not by calendar week.
- `tripMonthWeeks` _function_: The Month view's rows: whole weeks, Monday first, from the week the trip starts in to the week it ends in, so the trip sits in its calendar and a two-month trip reads as one run of weeks.
- `parkInitials` _function_: The two-letter mark of a park for the Month view's chips, from the words that name the park: Magic Kingdom MK, Hollywood Studios HS, Epic Universe EU, SeaWorld SW, EPCOT EP, and Universal Studios Florida US, where "Studios" alone would say …
- `daySeasons` _function_: The curated seasons a park's day lists (its cell's `seasons`), cancelled ones and closures left out: what the day sheet names as the day's events.
- `partySeason` _function_: The separately ticketed season behind a day's evening event, if the calendar names one.
- `dayGuestHours` _function_: Hours a day guest has on a park's day, from the calendar's open to its day-guest close.
- `hoursLessThanUsual` _function_: How many hours shorter a park's day is for a day guest than the park's usual day in the calendar window (its median), rounded to whole hours: the figure "about 4 hours less than a usual day here" says.
- `swapPreview` _function_: The change in big-ride minutes if the park of day `a` traded places with day `b`'s park (or day off): the two parks' waits on their new days less those on their old ones.
- `dateFigure` _function_: The figure under a date: the lower of the day's picks per resort (`best`, the API's shortest lines with early closings counted), so a party night that closes at 6 pm never makes a date look quiet.
- `TRIP_WEEK_PX_PER_MIN` _const_: The trip overview's scale: half the day planner's, on a phone and off it, so a whole park day fits a screen while a phone keeps the planner's larger step.
- `TRIP_WEEK_PX_PER_MIN_COARSE` _const_: `TRIP_WEEK_PX_PER_MIN` on a phone.
- `WEEK_COLUMNS_WIDE` _const_: Days per page of the Week view: a week on a wide screen, three on a phone.
- `WEEK_COLUMNS_PHONE` _const_: `WEEK_COLUMNS_WIDE` on a phone.
- Types: `TripBlockSpan`, `TripDaySpan`, `TripCanvas`, `TripMonthCell`, `SwapPreview`

### [`plan-when.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/plan-when.ts)

- `whenPeriods` _function_: The ranges behind the period chips, in park time: the next twelve months, the next calendar year, and its spring (March–May), summer (June–August) and autumn (September–November).
- `clipSearchRange` _function_: A search range cut to what the API searches, from `today` to a year ahead, or `null` where fewer than `days` days are left in it, which `/when` would answer with a 400.
- `monthSearchRange` _function_: A crowd-calendar month as the When mode's search: the trip of the default length found inside that month, from `today` on. `null` where the rest of the month is shorter than the trip.
- `whenPeriodOf` _function_: Which chip a search range is: one of `whenPeriods`, else `custom`.
- `whenRequestQuery` _function_: The `/when` request's query: the search, the length, the holiday region, the three windows the cards show, and the trip options `/plan` takes, pins aside. `null` outside the When mode.
- `windowReasons` _function_: A window's reasons this client can say, in order.
- `windowWarnings` _function_: A window's warnings this client can say, in order.
- `percentBelowAverage` _function_: How far a window lies below the range's average, in whole percent: "27 % below the period's average". `null` where it is not below or a figure is missing; a window above average is never sold as a saving.
- `weekTiers` _function_: The year strip's tint per week: where the week's figure falls among the range's weeks, in five equal shares from the quietest to the busiest.
- `weekInWindow` _function_: Whether a week overlaps a window, for marking the window on the strip.
- `holidayRegionsFor` _function_: The holiday data's regions grouped by country, the locale's own country first, each country's regions in the order the data lists them. Only what the data has: a region it lacks is not offered.
- `rankedLower` _function_: Why a window ranks lower than its plain minutes say: the season terms `/when` added (`penalties`, minutes per park day). "ranked lower: hurricane season" beside an unchanged figure.
- `WHEN_LIMIT` _const_: Windows the result asks for: the three cards of Level 0.
- `WHEN_REASON_ORDER` _const_: The reasons a window can carry, most telling first; the card shows the first.
- `WHEN_WARNING_ORDER` _const_: The warnings a window can carry, most consequential first.
- `WHEN_HOLIDAY_COUNTRIES` _const_: The countries the picker asks the holiday data for: where park.fan's visitors live, one per locale.
- Types: `WhenPeriodKey`, `WhenPeriod`, `WhenReasonCode`, `WhenWarningCode`, `WhenHolidayCountry`

### [`plan.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/plan.ts)

- `planRequestQuery` _function_: The `/plan` request's query, or `null` while the plan cannot be asked for: no dates yet, or a problem `planProblem` names, which the API would answer with a 400.
- `tripDates` _function_: Every date of the trip, both ends included; empty without both dates.
- `parkDaysAvailable` _function_: Days a park can go on: the trip, less a free arrival and a free departure day.
- `effectiveParks` _function_: The parks the plan is asked for: the visitor's picks, or the headliners while untouched.
- `minimumVisits` _function_: The fewest visits the choice asks for: a count that is left to the split counts as one.
- `planProblem` _function_: The first reason the plan cannot be asked for, or `null`. These are the 400s the API would answer, caught before the request so each gets a sentence and a way out instead of an error.
- `fixedNights` _function_: The nights the visitor fixed across the bases (`bases=tokyo:4,nagoya:1` is five).
- `setBaseNights` _function_: Fix a base's nights, or leave them to the plan (`null`), keeping the base's area. A base with neither nights nor an area left leaves `bases`, unless `keep`: a city the visitor added stays a stay whose nights the plan picks.
- `setBaseArea` _function_: Name a base's hotel area, or none (`null`). A base at `:0` has no stay to name one for.
- `addBase` _function_: Add a base the plan does not stay in, its nights left to the plan.
- `releaseBase` _function_: Take a base out of `bases`: the plan decides again whether to stay there.
- `setGateway` _function_: The trip's arrival or departure base, from the gateway the visitor picked; `null` for a gateway several bases share, or none: the plan picks.
- `setMoveBuffer` _function_: The hotel change's buffer; the region's own default is written as nothing.
- `pinnedRepeatVisits` _function_: The visits the choice pins beyond the first: a park written with two or three days. Only these can make a trip too short for the API; a park without a count, or with one, is left out of the plan when no day is left (`parksLeftOut`) instead.
- `visitSteps` _function_: The counts a park's stepper walks, in order: with the split on, its "1–2 days" sits between one and two.
- `stepVisits` _function_: The next count of a park's stepper, one step along `visitSteps`. A count left to the split reads "1–2 days" with the split on and one without it. The stepper never removes a park: its checkbox does.
- `setParkVisits` _function_: Set one park's count: `0` removes it, `null` leaves it to the split. The first edit turns the untouched default (the headliners) into an explicit list, kept in the region's order.
- `setSplit` _function_: Turn the split on or off. Off, a count left to the split becomes one, so the stepper keeps showing what will be planned.
- `tripHotelKinds` _function_: The hotel kinds the planner offers: the API's `hotels` where it sends them, each with the area the registry pairs it with, else the registry's own. A region may have several hotel areas or none; a kind without an area moves no drive times.
- `effectiveHotel` _function_: The hotel the API plans with: the chosen one, else the area's usual hotel (the region's first kind in that area), else off-site.
- `chooseHotel` _function_: Choose a hotel. Where no area is set yet, the hotel's own area follows (the region's `hotels`), so drive times appear without a second question; an area the visitor chose stays.
- `setTripDates` _function_: Set the trip's dates; pins outside them go.
- `lockOn` _function_: Whether a day carries a pin, and which.
- `toggleLock` _function_: Pin a day to what it holds now (a park or a rest day), or release its pin.
- `dayLockTarget` _function_: What a pin of this day names: its park, `rest`, or nothing for a travel or hop day.
- `swapLocks` _function_: The pins after trading two days' contents: what was on `a` goes to `b` and the other way round, both pinned, so the re-plan keeps the trade and moves only the rest. Pins elsewhere stay.
- `plannerParkOf` _function_: The region park as the day planner stores it, or `null` where its path names no geography.
- `reserveTripDays` _function_: Every park day of the plan as `reserveDays` takes it, a hop day's two parks on one date, each park and date once, in trip order.
- `findLeg` _function_: The leg between two points of the region (park slugs or `hotel:<key>`). The matrix stores each pair once, both directions averaged, so either order finds it.
- `setFindMode` _function_: Switch between the two ways in: the visitor knows the dates, or the planner finds them. Finding starts on `range` with the length of the dates chosen so far (or `DEFAULT_FIND_DAYS`); knowing drops the search.
- `planWindow` _function_: Level 3 of the When mode: plan a found window, which leaves the search for the plan itself.
- Types: `PlanDayKind`, `PlanMove`, `PlanStay`, `PlanStaySuggestion`, `PlanTravel`, `PlanParkVisit`, `PlanDay`, `PlanHopperDay`, `PlanHopperVerdict`, `PlanOwnedTicket`, `PlanTicketAlternative`, `PlanTicketSuggestion`, `PlanEveningHighlight`, `PlanEvening`, `PlanAlternative`, `PlanParkSummary`, `PlanTotals`, `PlanMeta`, `TripPlan`, `PlanProblem`, `PlanReservePark`
- Re-exports: `./plan-query`

"Start the planner", as a signal from outside the planner: the hub's hero action asks, the mounted `TripRegionPlanner` answers.

- `tripPlannerUi` _const_: The trip planner's open signal.

### [`region-messages.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/region-messages.ts)

- `getRegionTranslations` _function_: A region's own copy on the server: `tripRegions.<slug>.<part>` (the hub's intro and FAQ, the best-time pages' titles, the planner's hotel names).

### [`region-words.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/region-words.ts)

### [`registry.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/registry.ts)

- `tripRegionConfig` _function_: A region by its slug, live or not.
- `liveTripRegion` _function_: A live region by its slug, or `undefined`: what a page or a link may answer for.
- `requireTripRegion` _function_: A region that has to exist, for code holding a slug that came from a page of that region. An unknown slug is a programming error, never a visitor's, so it throws.
- `tripRegionSegment` _function_: A region's URL segment in a locale, the English one where a locale lacks its own.
- `tripRegionBySegment` _function_: The live region and locale a URL segment belongs to: `kalifornien` is German, `california` is English, Spanish and Italian. Every locale that spells the region so, in the list's order.
- `bestTimePageOf` _function_: The best-time page of a region by its id (`region` or a resort segment).
- `tripRegionTitle` _function_: A region as the admin names it, which writes in no reader's language: the slug in title case, `southern-california` → „Southern California“.
- `TRIP_REGIONS` _const_: Every trip region, live or coming, in the order the planner band and the admin list them.
- `LIVE_TRIP_REGIONS` _const_: The regions whose pages answer and whose links show.
- `PARK_NAME_SUFFIXES` _const_: Every park-name suffix of every region, for `shortParkName`, which is called without one.
- Types: `TripRegionSceneProps`, `TripRegionSceneLoader`, `TripBestTimePage`, `TripTicketStep`, `TripHubFaq`, `TripHub`, `TripHotelKind`, `TripRegionConfig`

### [`relay.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/relay.ts)

- `tripRegionRelayTarget` _function_: The upstream request for a relay path and query, or `null` when the relay answers 400: a region the registry does not list, an unknown route, a parameter the route does not take or a value that is not one.
- `TRIP_REGION_CACHE_CONTROL` _const_: The region the open route is cached a day for, the API's own window, and an hour for the keyed ones, which the API keeps an hour in Redis. Repeated in `next.config.ts`, where the two must agree.
- `TRIP_REGION_DATA_CACHE_CONTROL` _const_: The keyed routes' window at the edge and in the browser: the API's hour.
- Types: `TripRegionRelayTarget`

### [`routes.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/routes.ts)

- `tripRegionFolder` _function_: The internal route folder of a region in a locale, which only rewrites reach.
- `tripRegionRedirects` _function_: Every region's redirects: the internal route folder to the region's own segment; another locale's spelling of the region (`/de/california`) and of the best-time segment (`/de/orlando/best-time-to-visit`) to the locale's own; and an …
- `tripRegionRewrites` _function_: Every region's rewrites onto its one route folder: the best-time pages first (the locale's own segment onto the folder's English one), then the hub and anything under it, which the route parses as a month or answers with a 404.
- `tripRegionHeaders` _function_: Every region's edge windows, on the URLs a browser asks for (a header rule matches the incoming path, before any rewrite).
- `TRIP_HUB_WINDOW` _const_: An hour fresh: the hub names the region's today, and its figures are an hour old at most.
- `TRIP_MONTH_WINDOW` _const_: Twelve hours fresh: a month page's forecast is rebuilt twice a day.
- Types: `TripRegionRedirect`, `TripRegionRewrite`, `TripRegionWindow`

### [`ticket-answer.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/ticket-answer.ts)

- `tripTicketAnswer` _function_: Whether this browser answered "Do you already have tickets?", so the walk asks once and the Tickets row knows how to word itself.

### [`trip-links.ts`](../../lib/trip-regions/trip-links.ts)

- `tripRegionLinks` _function_: A region answer reduced to its links, or `null` for a region the registry does not list as live (one the API curates before its hub exists), whose links would lead nowhere.
- `regionParksOf` _function_: The region's parks among `keys`, each a park's UUID or its locale-free path, in the region's order and each once.
- `findTripRegion` _function_: The first region that holds one of `keys`, with the parks it holds, or `null`.
- `tripPlannerHref` _function_: The locale-relative address of a region's planner on a state, for `Link` from `@/i18n/navigation`. Without a state it is the bare chapter (`/orlando#planner`).
- `matchTripRegion` _function_: The region a search query names, or `null`. A query names a region when one of its words is the region's name ("orlando", or "orl" while typing), or when two words or more run along a resort's name ("disney world", "universal orlando").
- Types: `TripRegionLinkPark`, `TripRegionLinks`
